name: Release Preparation
description: Prepare a release candidate with source context, readiness, dependency, CI, documentation, and handoff evidence.
approval_boundaries: Do not publish, deploy, or tag without explicit authorization.
Escalate missing rollback or required validation.

phases.name: Release context
phases.instructions: Identify release scope, target, rules, commands, and current evidence.

phases.name: Readiness assessment
phases.instructions: Assess compatibility, migrations, versioning, changelog, rollback, and known risk.

phases.name: Dependency review
phases.instructions: Check lockfiles, runtime pins, and dependency drift.

phases.name: Delivery validation
phases.instructions: Run or inspect required validation and delivery gates.

phases.name: Release documentation
phases.instructions: Update required release notes, usage docs, or migration guidance.

phases.name: Release handoff
phases.instructions: Prepare the release decision record without performing the release.
